title: genista angulata
intro: Genista angulata, commonly known as Angle Bush or Angle Spurry, is a type of flowering plant in the legume family. It is used for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiparasitic properties, making it effective in treating various health conditions. The therapeutic actions of Genista angulata include soothing digestive issues, reducing fever, and aiding in wound healing due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
